name: CE_EXTERNAL_TRANSACTIONS
description: CE_EXTERNAL_TRANSACTIONS contains information related to external transactions.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: System generated identifier that is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: RECON_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for reconciliation history in which the transaction is reconciled.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bank account to which the transaction belongs.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the business unit to which the transaction belongs.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the legal entity to which the transaction belongs.

columns.name: REFERENCE_TEXT
columns.description: External transaction reconciliation reference.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: System generated sequence number to number the transactions.

columns.name: STATEMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Statement line from which the transaction is created. It is updated when the transaction source is of type statement.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the external transaction was created.

columns.name: VALUE_DATE
columns.description: Actual value date of the transaction.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether to raise accounting event when reconciled.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status to indicate whether this is a reconciled, unreconciled, or void transaction.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Source from where this transaction is created.  Possible values are: MANUAL (manually entered), IMPORT (imported), STMT (created from statement line), or RECON_DIFF (balancing transaction created from reconciliation amount difference).

columns.name: ASSET_CCID
columns.description: Cash general ledger account to be used when accounted.

columns.name: OFFSET_CCID
columns.description: Offset general ledger account to be used when accounted.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CLEARED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the transaction is cleared.

columns.name: TRANSFER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the bank account transfer or ad hoc payment that created the external cash transaction.

columns.name: BANK_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: The conversion rate between the bank account currency and the ledger currency on the external transaction.

columns.name: BANK_CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: The type of conversion rate between the bank account currency and the ledger currency on the external transaction.

columns.name: TRX_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: The conversion rate between the transaction currency and the bank account currency on the external transaction.

columns.name: TRX_CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: The type of conversion rate between the transaction currency and the bank account currency provided on the external transaction.
